title: Fylgja NetBox reader document 1
description: What a read of NetBox is given beside its branch, that NetBox cannot hold: which manufacturer and platform pair is which platform package, and the name of the configuration context that declares the probes (D-095). The NetBox reader, fylgja-netbox, reads it with document.py, as YAML or JSON, and its wheel carries this file alone (D-084). It names no artifact, NetBox rendering each device's configuration itself, and holds no address and no credential: those are FYLGJA_NETBOX_ADDRESS and FYLGJA_NETBOX_TOKEN (D-042).
$comment: Rule the reader holds across rows: a pair of manufacturer and platform is in one row (reader.platform.duplicate). Pairs are compared exactly, letter case and spacing included. The document refers to no other file.

reader_version.description: The format's version; document.py refuses any other (reader.version.unsupported).

manufacturer.description: The name of the platform's manufacturer in NetBox (dcim.manufacturer); mapping.py matches a device's to it exactly.

platform.description: The name of the device's platform in NetBox (dcim.platform); mapping.py matches a device's to it exactly.

package.description: The platform package's id, as its platform package 1 document's id; mapping.py writes it as the blueprint device's platform, which the core's compiler loads.

items.description: One pair of manufacturer and platform and the platform package a device of that pair is; mapping.py refuses a device whose pair is in no row (platform.unmatched).

platforms.description: The pairs the read maps, in any order; mapping.py resolves each scoped device's platform package by them.

probes.description: The name of the configuration context that holds the probes, which is inactive, so that NetBox renders it into no device's configuration; probes.py reads it into the blueprint's probes. Null where the read reads none.
